subject: Trading
title: Naked Short Selling Options
description: Learn Naked Short Selling Options in one minute.

hook.text: A trader sells a naked call on GameStop. The stock triples overnight. The loss: $200,000—from a trade that earned $500.

buildup.text: Naked selling means writing options without owning the underlying stock or having an offsetting position.

discovery.text: Naked calls have theoretically unlimited loss potential. Naked puts can lose up to the entire strike price.

twist.text: Despite the risk, some traders sell naked options for the high probability of profit. Until one event wipes them out.

climax.text: Every year, accounts blow up from naked short options. The strategy works until it doesn't—and then it's catastrophic.

punchline.text: Unlimited risk for limited reward. The math is cruel.

quiz.question: What is the risk of selling naked call options?
options: Theoretically unlimited—losses grow with no cap
